dungeons.blurb: Beneath the plaza: a sealed vault of commits nobody merged. The history is corrupt and a machine still asks for a repair.
dungeons.name: The Forgotten Repository

dungeons.blurb: A decommissioned hall that still serves traffic to nobody. The logs will tell you what happened if you ask the right questions.
dungeons.name: Derelict Data Center

dungeons.blurb: The Foundry's abandoned floor. An experimental machine ran a thousand experiments and recorded every one. Recover the ones that mattered.
dungeons.name: The Experimental Machine Floor
